title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape
abstract: arXiv:2609.37416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all scales, to the mean-squared error of a uniform quantizer applied to a standard Gaussian; we verify the effective-rank condition for wide, randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and isotropic Gaussian calibration data. The limiting objective has a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose scale decreases strictly with the number of levels and whose curvature with respect to relative scale errors decays approximately exponentially with

translated_title: 低比特训练后量化中的尺度敏感性：量化误差景观的曲率
translated_abstract: GPTQ系列中的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在一个必须选定尺度的均匀网格上最小化逐层重构误差，而常用的基于最大值的尺度选择方法在低比特宽度下性能会急剧下降。本文研究了该目标函数对尺度的敏感程度。对于权重独立同分布服从高斯分布、且校准激活值具有足够大有效秩的层，作者证明：随着宽度增长，归一化的最近舍入损失以高概率在所有尺度上一致收敛于将均匀量化器作用于标准高斯分布所得的均方误差；并针对具有奇Lipschitz激活函数和各向同性高斯校准数据的宽随机初始化多层感知机（MLP）验证了有效秩条件。该极限目标函数具有唯一的非退化极小值点，其尺度随量化级数严格递减，且其关于相对尺度误差的曲率随（摘要在此截断）近似呈指数衰减。
tldr: 该论文从理论上证明了大宽度神经网络层的最近舍入量化损失在所有尺度上一致收敛于一个具有唯一非退化极小值点的极限目标函数，并通过其曲率随尺度的指数衰减特性，从理论上解释了低比特训练后量化中基于最大值的尺度选择方法失效的原因。
en_tdlr: The paper theoretically proves that the round-to-nearest quantization loss of wide neural network layers converges uniformly over all scales to a limiting objective with a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose curvature decays exponentially, thereby explaining the failure of max-based scale selection in low-bit post-training quantization.
